title: A single factor root named alone ("one number is 3") still passes leaks()
body:
## Summary
leaks() now catches a factor item's roots named as a pair, but not one root on its own.

## Description
factor-leak (1cd0297) covers pairs in leaksByForm for equations and sums to factor. A hint naming one root ("one of the numbers is 3") gives half the answer and is not caught. Extend the same check to a single root in an answer-giving phrase, keeping the method phrasings ("what multiplies to 12") clean.

## Flow
- hint for x^2 - 7x + 12 = 0: "one of the numbers is 3"
- leaks() -> false

## Expected impact
Closes the half-answer leak on factor items.

## Evaluation
Claim: policy-tighten - single-root phrasings caught
Before: 0
After: all
Method: probe - builder report
Result: better
Gate: policy-tighten

title: The phone reply box accepts typing before the scene has its first line
body:
## Summary
On the talk screen before the first partner line, the phone lets the learner type and send; the server refuses it.

## Description
The server answers "Prepare the scene before sending a reply." but the phone reply box is enabled. The turn table (desk/src/lib/english/turn.ts) already knows the send is refused; the reply box should read it and stay disabled with a two-word state.

## Flow
- start a Linga scene
- type on the phone before the first line arrives
- send -> refused

## Expected impact
No typed reply is lost to a refusal.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - sends refused after typing
Before: 1 per early send
After: 0
Method: gate - linga-rules-test renders the box
Result: better
Gate: none

title: End session says "Nothing written down tonight." after the TV already wrote it
body:
## Summary
Once the TV's Menu has written the evening down, the phone's End session reports nothing written.

## Description
tv-recap (054c317) made /api/memory skip a repeat write for the same evening. The phone reads the skip as "nothing" and says so, which is false: the evening was written, by the TV. It should say it is already written.

## Flow
- landing, press Menu (evening written)
- phone: End session
- phone reads "Nothing written down tonight."

## Expected impact
The phone stops telling the parent the evening was lost.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - copy matches what happened
Before: wrong sentence
After: right sentence
Method: simulation - builder observation
Result: better
Gate: none
